0022600220.text: The Bulls (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak and 14th in the East) host the San Antonio Spurs (9-2, on a nine-game winning streak and 1st in the Southwest) in Chicago's 10th game of the season. Chicago is without Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation), Tobe Awaka (back) and Zach Collins (illness), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), both out, and Devin Vassell (groin), who is day-to-day. The Bulls lost the 2025-26 season series 0-2, including a 129-114 defeat in San Antonio on March 30, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
